# Best Buy

> > Best Buy is a leading consumer electronics retailer offering 725K+ products through 1,000+ stores, with developer APIs, Geek Squad services, and seasonal promotions featuring brands like Samsung, Apple, and Sony.

Best Buy operates as both a major retail destination and technology platform, providing comprehensive shopping experiences alongside developer tools for accessing product and store data. The company employs 85,000+ staff and maintains robust API infrastructure for third-party integrations.
